answer: Progressive stake-and-tenure tiers: every new identity starts in a sandbox — no rewards, no attestations. Privileges unlock tier by tier only after it anchors escalating stake to the ledger and completes a streak of service work; each tier demands more stake and more tenure, so trust compounds like a juniper growing one ring per season. Misbehavior slashes the stake and resets tenure. A sybil farmer must age each puppet through every tier — 10,000 fakes means 10,000 locked stakes and 10,000 yarrow-like service histories tended for months, costing far more than the puppets could ever harvest.
